code.description: What the attempt hit: dns_not_found, dns_error, connect_refused, connect_timeout, tls_error, timeout or transport for a request nothing answered, else the provider's own code or http_<status>. The set may grow; treat an unknown code as text.

message.description: One sentence naming the endpoint host only. It may change between builds; key on code.

at.description: When the node recorded the attempt.

delivery.description: The delivery ULID. Matches X-Tmesis-Delivery. Duplicated in the body so a receiver that logs bodies has the dedupe key without the headers.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, when the event happened on the node. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival: delivery is unordered.

stream.description: The stream the generation came from; null for a job generation, which names job_id instead.

session.description: The publish session the generation came from; null for a job generation.

session_epoch.description: The session's epoch, the publish identity. Not the fencing epoch. Null for a job generation.

job_id.description: The transcode job a JOB generation belongs to (P10); null for a stream's. Its events route to the job's callback_url.

generation.description: The immutable output generation (a ULID). Every artifact route and event keys on this.

inventory_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the generation's committed inventory, 64 lowercase hex digits.

last_attempt.description: The cause of the object's latest failed attempt; null when the failure rests on no attempt (local evidence, or a budget found spent at restart before any recorded cause).
